questions.q: Man is the only animal ( who ) can talk.
questions.s:

questions.q: No one of them came to the inauguration of our new Factory.
questions.s:
Explanation:- 'No one' aur 'none' me kuchh difference hota hai jaise ki,

(a) 'none' insaano aur cheezo dono ke liye aa sakta hai. 'no one' generally sirf insaano ke liye use kiya jaata hai.

(b) 'none' ko kisi 'Group me se koi nahi' kehne liye use kar sakte hai, but 'no one' 'group me se koi nahi' wala meaning dene ke liye use nahin hota hai. Yahan group me se koi nahi wala meaning dena hai, isliye 'no one' nahi 'none' ka use hoga.

questions.q:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

It was him who encouraged I when I was feeling low.
questions.s:
The correct answer is- he who encouraged me​.

 ​​

  • Subjective pronouns (he, she, it) are used as the subject whereas objective pronouns (him, her, itself) are used as the object of the sentence.
  • ​The pronouns that connect a clause or phrase to a noun or a pronoun, is called a relative pronoun.
  • The most common relative pronouns are:
    • who, whom, whose, which, that.
  • Example:
    • We don’t know the person who donated this money.
    • You need to tick the box which says yes.​
  • ​We use 'who' in relative clauses to refer to people, and sometimes to pet animals. (refer to the above example)
  • ​As per the rule given above, 'he who encouraged me​' will be used in the underlined part of the sentence.​
  • The past participle i.e. encouraged of the given verb has been used as the given sentence is in the past tense.
     

​​Correct Sentence: It was he who encouraged me when I was feeling low.

questions.q:
After / a long and fun-filled day, / the children / slept themselves peacefully.

[SSC CHSL 24/05/2022 S3]
o: a long and fun-filled day
questions.s:
Correct Answer: slept themselves peacefully

  • The word "themselves" is a reflexive pronoun. Reflexive pronouns are used when the subject and the object of the verb are the same. However, the verb "slept" does not require or allow a reflexive pronoun, as it is an intransitive verb and does not take an object.

Correct Sentence: After a long and fun-filled day, the children slept peacefully.

questions.q:
The given sentence contains a grammatical error. Identify the segment that contains the error.

The man whose sitting at the corner table is my uncle.
questions.s:
The erroneous part is 'whose sitting'.

Key Points

  • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
  • Here, 'who is sitting' should be used instead of 'whose sitting'.
  • 'Who' is a subject pronoun that is used to describe who performed an action or who is in a specific state.
  • 'Whose' is a possessive pronoun that refers to the person to whom something belongs.
  • Here, in the given sentence 'who' is referring to the subject 'the man'.
  • Thus, the correct answer is Option 1.
     

Correct Sentence: The man who is sitting at the corner table is my uncle. 

Hinglish 

  • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है।
  • यहां 'whose sitting' के स्थान पर 'who is sitting' का प्रयोग करना चाहिए।
  • 'Who' एक subject pronoun है जिसका उपयोग यह वर्णन करने के लिए किया जाता है कि किसने कार्रवाई की या किसी विशिष्ट स्थिति में कौन है।
  • 'Whose' एक possession pronoun है जो उस व्यक्ति को संदर्भित करता है जिसके पास कुछ है।
  • यहाँ, दिए गए वाक्य में 'who' विषय 'the man' की बात कर रहा है।
  • अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।
